summary: Frontend-only QA of the light/maroon re-theme and new nav, using the disposable analysis bridge (127.0.0.1:8773) with hero/old/friend cookies at 1920x800/1000 and 390x844, in light and dark mode. Working: light is the default on every page checked. The theme-toggle switches html between light and dark, saves the choice in localStorage 'jeelive-theme' and keeps it after reload. Desktop header: pill nav (the active link is a black pill), a non-clickable Rapid Fire gem, and an account menu with all 7 items. Desktop shows no bottom tabs. Phone shows the black bottom-tabs bar with a white active tab, the 4 links go to the right pages, Rapid Fire is a DIV that does not navigate, the bar is hidden in the player and for signed-out visitors, the footer is hidden, the account icon shows (16px) and header-nav is hidden. Home greeting, series card text and links, practice cards and For-you links/badges all match the spec. Rank: 6 non-clickable tiles with SOON badges that do not overlap the text at 390. Mission: CTA goes to /home. My Tests: segmented tabs with counts, chips filter and update the URL (exam=BITSAT / JEE+Main, status=completed), search, date picker (shadcn calendar), refresh, display-name dialog, and the Open analysis / Solutions links all work. Player: black-maroon header, light palette colours (answered green, marked purple, visited light red, current black outline), answer, mark, Next and the Review & submit dialog work. Get Ready card is dark and Begin now works. Results: dark score card, green/red/amber tiles, black active tab pill, dark a2-block-score, and the a2-bar sits at bottom 66px above the tabs. No horizontal overflow at 390 on any page tested. No console errors. An automated contrast scan of 9 pages in both modes found no low-contrast text after the fixes below. I found and fixed 3 regressions and added 1 missing testid. One minor issue remains for the main agent: the Rapid Fire gem overlaps the results a2-bar section pills on phone.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: app-theme.css .feature-dark sets position:relative, which overrode App.css .player-header{position:sticky}. As a result the black header and timer scrolled away while .player-savebar stayed stuck at top 72/80px, leaving a gap with question text showing above it. Fix: added position:sticky; top:0; z-index:30 to .player-header.feature-dark.

FIXED by testing agent: the h1 'Deep breath. You've got this.' was rgb(11,11,15) on the dark card in light mode, so it could not be seen. Cause: global h1,h2,h3{color:var(--navy)}, and --navy is resolved at :root from the light --ink. Fix: added --navy:#FFFFFF to the .feature-dark tokens, which also covers any other h1-h3 inside dark featured cards.

FIXED by testing agent: '.light .streak-journey' made the background white, but series-streak.css still hard-codes white text. As a result 'Your 50-day run.' (streak-title), the h3 'Consistency, collected.' and the streak-days-toggle summary were white on white. Fix: added color:var(--ink) for the light streak-journey and its h2/h3/summary.

ui_bugs.component: Phone bottom tabs Rapid Fire gem vs results a2-bar
ui_bugs.issue: NOT FIXED. On /results/<id> at 390px the gem image rises above the bar (top ~748, x 173-217) and covers part of the stuck a2-bar's section pill '2 Performance' (y 731-771). elementFromPoint there returns the gem IMG (pointer-events:auto), so the middle of that pill cannot be tapped. Suggested fix: give the gem pointer-events:none, or raise body.has-tabs .a2-bar bottom by ~30px, or move the pill row up.

issues: 'Log in' is hidden in the header on phone; only 'Start free' shows. Returning users have no direct login entry in the header (on desktop it is visible).
The '61 / 120' text inside the big ring is very small (~14px) compared with the ring. Consider a larger score number.
The status chip row scrolls sideways inside itself and the 4th chip is cut off at the right edge with no fade or scroll hint.
The profile box (name/number) does not span the full width on phone (~303 of 350px).
The translucent header lets the red series card tint show through while scrolling. Minor.

action_items: Fix the Rapid Fire gem covering the results a2-bar section pills on phone (pointer-events:none on .bottom-tab-rapid img and/or raise the a2-bar offset).
Review the 3 CSS fixes made in app-theme.css (sticky player header, --navy in .feature-dark, light streak text colours) and keep them.
Optional: show 'Log in' on the phone signed-out header; enlarge the score number in the analysis ring; add a scroll hint to the chip row.
critical_code_review_comments: app-theme.css .feature-dark forces position:relative and overflow:hidden on every element that uses it. Any sticky or fixed element given this class (as player-header was) breaks. Keep a per-component override, or move position:relative into a wrapper.

Any rule that uses var(--navy) or other :root-derived aliases (--brand-navy) does not follow the --ink overrides inside .feature-dark. Check other derived tokens (e.g. --brand-navy) if they are used inside dark cards.
App.js Shell shows BottomTabs for every signed-in user on all routes except /attempts, including staff routes such as /super-admin. Confirm this is intended.
The legacy dark-only stylesheets (series-streak.css, vibrant-ui.css) hard-code white text. Other legacy sections may need .light overrides as more pages get light backgrounds.
